scope: DEI-T40/T47: atomic native report snapshots and unknown-outcome recovery

DEI:DEI-T47: submits the last batch once and preserves retry content

evidence: Added deterministic concurrent SQL sessions with real Board write fences: one report and one independent append start from the same revision. Both lock acquisition orders are exercised, with no sleeps used for ordering.

Only the first operation persists; the second receives a revision, version or frozen-state conflict. Committing after the caught conflict leaves exactly the winning record and no partial report. A winning report pins exactly that record and its manifest hash.

Added lost-response cases before and after commit. The interrupted caller receives TimeoutError in both cases. A separate session retries: creates once if rolled back, replays if committed, with exactly one record/report and stable event IDs on replay.
A stored report is not resubmitted by replay after rework. Current permissions are still checked on replay; different report content with the same key conflicts.
Report gate/selection/late failures roll back batch, inline execution and outbox even if the caller subsequently commits.
Closed manifest contracts reject old/missing versions, incomplete bases, foreign scopes, altered record hashes and altered impact without conversion.
Existing current frontend campaign verifies stable retry payloads, changed-input keys, no double submit, preservation of queued entries and rejection of silently rebased revisions.

tests.frontend_reused: 11 passed in native-delivery-impact-report-frontend3.json; reviewed relevant report/retry cases, unchanged since f892cceb, no new frontend run or double count

limits: Concurrency uses the supported Community SQLite engine and actual relational fences; does not claim a different database runtime.
Transport tests control principal admission; they are not a complete installed-authentication E2E.
A client without a confirmed append cannot reconstruct unsubmitted external workspace edits. Recovery covers durable records and exact retries, not code recovery.
No product/SPA change. Current main86 provenance and closure remain applicable, eight budgets zero.
No legacy conversion, promotion or real-data mutation. DEI-T42 remains separate because raw fixture rework is not proof of the full authorized reopening flow.
